text:
Kyla Tran: Hey team — I started today! Quick access Qs: I can't see the CS pipeline in HubSpot and Aircall shows 'unassigned'. Who do I ping for HubSpot seat + Aircall routing? Also where's the CS playbook for discovery call scripts?

Raj (IT): @Kyla what's your employee ID and confirmed email? I can check seat entitlements. Did you finish SSO setup and MFA?

Kyla Tran: Employee ID 8342, email is kyla@redwood.com. I went through SSO but MFA failed — it shows `403 - device not allowed` when I try to add my phone.

Raj (IT): Try in incognito or while on the company VPN first. If still 403, send me a screenshot and I'll force enroll you.

Mia Lee: Welcome Kyla! Playbook is in Confluence (CS > Playbooks > Enterprise Discovery). Quick tip for this week: lean on the 'BANT -> Outcomes' script on page 4. @Ben can reassign Aircall routing for SDR overflow to you.

Ben Ortiz: Adding Kyla to HubSpot now. Confirm the email is kyla@redwood.com and I'll grant the CS role. Also reassigning Aircall DN. Give me 5–10 min.

onboard-bot: Reminder: new-hire checklist — please complete 'Redwood Security Training' to finish provisioning.

Kyla Tran: Yep it's kyla@redwood.com. Screenshot attached of the MFA error. Thanks!

Ben Ortiz: HubSpot seat assigned. If you still can't see pipelines, in HubSpot go:
Settings > Objects > Deals > Pipelines
select 'CS - Post-Sign'
Aircall DN assigned — log into the Aircall desktop app using SSO and your company email.

Kyla Tran: I can see HubSpot now, pipelines visible. Aircall web app still shows 'No device'.

Alex Ng: For Aircall desktop make sure you have v2.1.4+ and microphone permissions enabled. Download: https://aircall.io/download. If web is flaky try the desktop app — it's much more stable for routing.

Kyla Tran: Installed the desktop app, mic works. One more: where are the voicemail scripts and the one-pager cheat-sheet for objection handling?

Mia Lee: Voicemail scripts + cheat-sheet are in the playbook under 'Call Assets'. I'll DM you the quick PDF and drop it in your onboarding folder in Drive. Also I'll set up a 3pm shadow with Jesse so you can listen to live calls.

Jesse Park: Happy to shadow — calendar invite sent for 3pm.

Kyla Tran: Thanks everyone! Marking checklist item done. :tada:

Ben Ortiz: If anything else blocks access ping me or @it-help and I'll escalate. Enjoy your first week!

Raj (IT): I forced an MFA enrollment for kyla@redwood.com. Try the SSO flow again and let me know.

Kyla Tran: SSO + MFA worked after the re-enroll. All set for now. Appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
